name: exists_ordinal

name: transfiniteCompositionOfShapeOfEqTop
statement: Type w} [LinearOrder J] [OrderBot J] [SuccOrder J] [WellFoundedLT J] {j : J} (hj : transfiniteIterate (largerSubobject hG) j (Subobject.mk f) = ⊤) : (generatingMonomorphisms G).pushouts.TransfiniteCompositionOfShape (Set.Iic j) f

name: exists_transfiniteCompositionOfShape
